content_sections.heading: PRATYUSH X-ray Technician Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: Upper age limit: 35 years. You must meet one of the following: B.sc in Radiography/Medical Imaging Technology or equivalent (3 years course) from a recognized University/Institution, with 2 years of experience in operating radio-diagnosis equipment in an established Institute/ Hospital/ Imaging Centre; OR DMIT with 3 years of experience in operating radio-diagnosis equipment in an established Institute/ Hospital/ Imaging Center. Experience will not be counted without a valid experience certificate. For exceptionally meritorious candidates, the Institute may at its discretion relax the age limit or experience, or offer higher pay, subject to approval of the competent authority. See the official notification (PDF) for the full eligibility conditions for this post.

content_sections.heading: Job Responsibilities
content_sections.text: Prepare patients for radiological procedures and take X-rays following established procedures for patient care and safety. Protect patients and staff from radiation exposure by following sound procedures that meet or exceed recommended industry standards. Process radiological film. Obtain quality diagnostic radiographs as requested by the Physician, PA or NP. Keep all equipment in good working condition and in line with applicable laws and regulations. Identify and file reports as required. Request, retrieve and track files to and from other departments or centres. Maintain the production and quality of radiographs by following set standards, developing radiographs, checking results and making adjustments. Working hours will be as set by the Health Centre.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: Contract period: The appointment is initially for 01 (one) year. It may be extended depending on performance and requirements. Nature: The position is purely temporary. Being called for interview or being selected gives no claim to a permanent post at IIT Bhubaneswar. Place of posting: IIT Bhubaneswar. Jurisdiction: Any dispute about the selection will be heard only by the Courts/Tribunals in Bhubaneswar.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection will be through a Written Test/Skill Test and/or an Interview. If many applications come in, suitable shortlisting criteria may be used to decide how many candidates are called. Meeting the eligibility criteria alone does not guarantee a call for the selection test. Shortlisted candidates will be told the date, time and details of the test by email or telephone. After selection, only the selected candidate will be informed by email. Any form of canvassing will lead to disqualification.

faq.question: Q1. Where will the X-ray Technician work?
faq.answer: At IIT Bhubaneswar. Working hours are set by the Health Centre.

faq.question: Q2. Can I apply with a DMIT instead of a B.Sc?
faq.answer: Yes. With a DMIT you need 3 years of experience operating radio-diagnosis equipment in an established Institute, Hospital or Imaging Center. With a B.Sc, 2 years is enough.

faq.question: Q3. What is the deadline time for sending the application?
faq.answer: Your email must arrive by 5:00 PM on 2 November 2026. Applications that arrive after this may be rejected.

faq.question: Q4. Do I need to post a hard copy of the form?
faq.answer: No. The notice says no hard copy is needed. The emailed form and PDF scans are enough.

faq.question: Q5. Is this a permanent job at IIT Bhubaneswar?
faq.answer: No. It is an outsourced, purely temporary post, initially for one year, and it may be extended based on performance and requirements. Appointment and payment are handled by the outsourced agency.

faq.question: Q6. Will my experience count without a certificate?
faq.answer: No. Experience is not considered without a valid experience certificate. Employed applicants should also attach their last salary slip.

faq.question: Q7. How will I know if I am shortlisted?
faq.answer: Shortlisted candidates will be told the date, time and details of the Written Test/Skill Test and/or Interview by email or telephone. The mobile number and email ID on the form are therefore mandatory.

faq.question: Q8. Can the age limit be relaxed?
faq.answer: For exceptionally meritorious candidates, the Institute may at its discretion relax the 35-year age limit or the experience requirement, subject to approval of the competent authority.

faq.question: Q9. Whom can I contact for clarification?
faq.answer: Contact PRATYUSH by email at [email protected] or by phone at 0671-3508897, 9437423794, 9237398100 or 9237398188.
